title: On Adoration and Worship in Spirit and Truth, Book 1
blurb: Cyril and Palladius on why Christ fulfills the Law rather than tearing it up. Book 1 of a seventeen-book dialogue — not the whole work.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Cyril’s long On Adorations (seventeen books) — no previous complete free English. This is Book 1 only. The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Migne PG 68 (Aubert reprint). The PDF and a cleaned text of the same print were checked against each other. This page is Book 1 of seventeen. This is a reading translation for study, not a new critical edition of the Greek.

witnesses.name: PDF of PG 68 De adoratione
witnesses.coverage: Same print; Books 1–17 in the file, English here is Book 1
